Called Meeting of the City Council
Austin Tex May 14, 1883

Hon W A Taylor Mayor Presiding

Roll call present Aldermen Ramsey
Platt & Wilson

A fine of one dollar was entered
against alderman Kinney Metz Lawrence
Schuber Brueggerhoff Hupfield & Moeller
for none attendance at this meeting

City Clerk
